result.instructions: Tools for Formspree, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Show the newest submissions from this form with their dates and email addresses."; "Review recent spam submissions for enquiries that may have been misclassified."; "List this form's field names so I can choose which columns to read.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Formspree data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run formspree_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run formspree_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run formspree_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. formspree_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: formspree_list_submissions
tools.title: List submissions
tools.description: List the form's submissions (not spam), newest first by default. Each has its _date and one value per form field. Submissions hold visitors' personal data: ask for the columns you need. Filter by date with since; page with limit and offset. GET /forms/{hashid}/submissions.

since.description: Only submissions since this date, ISO format: 2026-10-01 or 2026-10-01T12:00:00 (the form of the Formspree docs, no timezone suffix).

offset.description: Number of submissions to skip (paging). Pass the previous reply's next_offset.

order.description: Sort by date: desc = newest first (default), asc = oldest first.

columns.description: Only these columns (field names, plus _date). Default: all columns. Ask for few columns: submissions hold personal data.

include_delivery_status.description: Also return each submission's delivery status (_status, lists notification recipients). Default false.

tools.name: formspree_list_spam_submissions
tools.title: List spam submissions
tools.description: List the submissions Formspree flagged or the owner marked as spam, newest first by default. Use it to check for false positives. Same filters and paging as formspree_list_submissions. GET /forms/{hashid}/submissions?spam=true.

since.description: Only submissions since this date, ISO format: 2026-10-01 or 2026-10-01T12:00:00 (the form of the Formspree docs, no timezone suffix).

offset.description: Number of submissions to skip (paging). Pass the previous reply's next_offset.

order.description: Sort by date: desc = newest first (default), asc = oldest first.

columns.description: Only these columns (field names, plus _date). Default: all columns. Ask for few columns: submissions hold personal data.

include_delivery_status.description: Also return each submission's delivery status (_status, lists notification recipients). Default false.

tools.name: formspree_get_form_fields
tools.title: Get form fields
tools.description: The field names (columns) of the form's submissions, taken from the latest 100 submissions. Returns names only, no submission data. Use it to pick the columns for formspree_list_submissions. GET /forms/{hashid}/submissions?limit=100.
